name: CAT-DE Pairs Mean Reversion Strategy
description: Pairs mean-reversion strategy on CAT (Caterpillar) and DE (Deere). Computes log price spread (log(CAT) - log(DE)), normalizes with a 60-day rolling z-score, and enters dollar-neutral positions when z exceeds ±2. Exits when z-score crosses back through zero. 50% allocation per leg for dollar-neutral exposure.
source:
# CAT-DE Pairs Mean Reversion Strategy
# Spread: log(CAT) - log(DE)
# Entry: z-score > +2 → Long DE / Short CAT
#         z-score < -2 → Long CAT / Short DE
# Exit: z-score crosses back through 0
# Sizing: 50% per leg (dollar-neutral)

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Reference the other asset's price for spread calculation
cat_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="CAT")()
de_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="DE")()
cat_close = cat_ref.c
de_close = de_ref.c

# --- Identify which asset is currently being processed ---
is_cat = is_asset_ref(ticker="CAT")()

# --- Spread Calculation ---
# Always compute spread as log(CAT) - log(DE) regardless of which asset is running
# When running on CAT: own price is CAT, reference is DE
# When running on DE: own price is DE, reference is CAT
spread = ln(cat_close) - ln(de_close)

# --- Z-Score of the Spread (60-day rolling window) ---
z = zscore(window=60)(spread)

# --- Entry Signals ---
# z > +2: CAT overpriced vs DE → Short CAT, Long DE
# z < -2: CAT underpriced vs DE → Long CAT, Short DE
z_high = z > 2.0
z_low = z < -2.0

# --- Exit Signals ---
# Exit when z-score crosses back through zero (mean reversion complete)
z_cross_above_zero = crossover(z, 0)
z_cross_below_zero = crossunder(z, 0)

# --- Per-Asset Signal Assignment ---
# CAT: long when z < -2 (CAT cheap), short when z > +2 (CAT expensive)
# DE:  long when z > +2 (DE cheap),  short when z < -2 (DE expensive)
long_enter = where(is_cat, z_low, z_high)
long_exit = where(is_cat, z_cross_above_zero, z_cross_below_zero)
short_enter = where(is_cat, z_high, z_low)
short_exit = where(is_cat, z_cross_below_zero, z_cross_above_zero)

# --- Hold State: persist entry signal until exit fires ---
long_state = hold_until()(enter=long_enter, exit=long_exit)
short_state = hold_until()(enter=short_enter, exit=short_exit)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_state, short_entry=short_state)

# 50% of equity per leg for dollar-neutral exposure
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)
